operating_notes.text: H.G. Gobindpur Tangi Highway Private Limited was incorporated on April 04, 2026 as a 100% SPV for the ₹1,582.11 Cr, 40.33 km NHAI six-lane ring-road HAM project in Odisha with a 910-day construction period.
H.G. Raipur Visakhapatnam OD-6 Private Limited contributed ₹329.10 Cr (6.5%) of FY25 consolidated revenue and ₹132.19 Cr (2.6%) of net worth at March 31, 2025; sold for ₹282.24 Cr.
Welspun Enterprises LOA for ₹3,931.11 Cr (excluding taxes), item-rate, 6-lane partially elevated Pune–Shirur corridor on NH-753F, minimum design length 53.40 Km, 36-month execution.

MSRDC returned the bid-security bank guarantees for H.G. Infra's L1 packages NC-04 (₹1,991.11 Cr, 28.20 km) and NC-05 (₹2,151.11 Cr, 31.75 km) on the Nagpur–Chandrapur expressway without stating reasons; the company excluded the ₹4,142.22 C

REC Power Development and Consultancy declared H.G. Infra a qualified bidder for two 220/132/33 kV AIS substations (Ranipur/Mau and Chunar/Mirzapur) with associated lines in Uttar Pradesh, BOOT, 35-year TSP period, 18-month execution, trans

REC Power Development and Consultancy declared H.G. Infra successful bidder for the WR-ER Inter-Regional Network Expansion Scheme – Part C in Jharkhand, BOOT, 35-year transmission service provider period, 30-month execution, transmission ch
Q4FY26 consolidated finance cost ₹136.79 Cr, up 93.5% YoY, with debt-service coverage at 0.47x for the quarter.
FY26 exceptional items of ₹51.03 Cr arose from divestment of HAM SPVs H.G. Khammam Devarapalle PKG-2 (₹1,077.70 million) and 49% of PKG-1 (₹682.72 million).
CBI/ACB Patna FIR dated January 21, 2026: four employees taken into custody, bail granted, no charge sheet filed; auditor emphasis of matter.
FY26 consolidated finance cost ₹468.60 Cr against EBITDA of ₹1,012.09 Cr; consolidated debt ₹4,933.93 Cr at March 2026.
HAM portfolio of 11 projects: total bid project cost ₹1,16,611 Mn, equity invested ₹12,100 Mn till FY26, project debt ₹25,718 Mn at March 2026.
MSRDC NC-4 & NC-5 projects (~₹4,142 Cr) removed from the order book, offset by new awards per the presentation.

NHAI declared May 30, 2026 as appointed date for H.G. Varanasi-Kolkata PKG-10 Highway Private Limited's ₹1,303.11 Cr, 35.600 km six-lane greenfield HAM package in Jharkhand, with a 730-day construction period.
Transferred 49% stake in H.G. Raipur Visakhapatnam OD-5 Private Limited for ₹377.40 Cr to Neo Infra Income Opportunities Fund.
Received provisional completion certificate for the ₹4,970.99 Cr Ganga Expressway Group II project from Adani Road Transport.

timeline.summary: On April 19, 2026, H.G. Infra said it had incorporated H.G. Gobindpur Tangi Highway Private Limited on April 04, 2026 as a 100% SPV for the ₹1,582.11 Cr NHAI six-lane ring-road HAM project in Odisha.

On April 23, 2026, H.G. Infra completed the sale of its 100% stake in H.G. Raipur Visakhapatnam OD-6 Private Limited to Neo Infra Income Opportunities Fund for ₹282.24 Cr, receiving ₹203.00 Cr on closing.
On April 28, 2026, H.G. Infra announced that ICRA reaffirmed its credit rating at [ICRA]AA- with a Positive outlook across ₹5,600 Cr of facilities.

On May 11, 2026, H.G. Infra received a Letter of Award from Welspun Enterprises Limited for a ₹3,931.11 Cr (excluding taxes) item-rate contract to build a 6-lane Pune–Shirur corridor on NH-753F in Maharashtra, to be executed in 36 months.

On May 20, 2026, H.G. Infra said MSRDC had returned the bid-security bank guarantees for its two L1 packages (NC-04 at ₹1,991.11 Cr and NC-05 at ₹2,151.11 Cr) without giving reasons, and that it would keep the ₹4,142.22 Cr of work out of its executable order book until MSRDC clarified.

On May 26, 2026, H.G. Infra said REC Power Development and Consultancy had declared it a qualified bidder for 220/132/33 kV AIS substations at Ranipur (Mau) and Chunar (Mirzapur) with associated lines in Uttar Pradesh, a BOOT transmission package with ₹45.01 Cr a year of transmission charges for 35 years and 18-month execution.

On May 27, 2026, H.G. Infra was declared successful bidder by REC Power Development and Consultancy for the WR-ER Inter-Regional Network Expansion Scheme – Part C in Jharkhand, a BOOT transmission project with ₹114.53 Cr a year of transmission charges for 35 years and 30-month execution.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,426.81 Cr (+4.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹85.09 Cr.

On May 28, 2026, H.G. Infra's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation reported consolidated revenue of ₹5,234.67 Cr (+3.5%) and PAT of ₹329.81 Cr (-34.7%), with the ~₹4,142 Cr MSRDC NC-4 & NC-5 projects removed from the order book.
H.G. Infra Engineering Limited shared the Q4 & FY2026 earnings conference call audio recording on May 29, 2026, via its website.
On June 1, 2026, H.G. Infra said NHAI declared May 30, 2026 as the appointed date for its wholly owned SPV's ₹1,303.11 Cr Varanasi-Kolkata HAM Package-10, with a 730-day construction period.
On June 2, 2026, H.G. Infra Engineering filed the transcript of its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call held on May 29, 2026.
H.G. Infra Engineering transferred a 49% stake in H.G. Raipur Visakhapatnam OD-5 Private Limited for ₹377.40 Cr.
On June 5, 2026, H.G. Infra received provisional completion for its ₹4,971 Cr Ganga Expressway Group-II EPC project from Adani Road Transport.
